title: The Situationship Reading

plan.title: Why you're still in it (it's not them)
What you actually want (not what you text)
How you read mixed signals at 2am
Too much of one thing, none of another
Your line, and when you've crossed it

plan2.title: Why you're still in it (it's not them)

intake.question: How long has this been going on?

options.label: On and off for over a year

intake.question: What do you want from it?

weeks.speaker: yeon
weeks.text: A few weeks, you said. A few weeks and you're already reading a comic about it. Noted.

months.speaker: bom
months.text: A few months. Long enough to have a song. Short enough that you still can't say "we".

half.speaker: yeon
half.text: Six months or more. That's not a situationship anymore. That's a lease with no contract.

onoff.speaker: yeon
onoff.text: On, off, on again, for more than a year. You two don't have a status. You have seasons.

unsaid.speaker: yeon
unsaid.text: You skipped "how long". Which tells me it's been longer than you'd like to admit.

me.speaker: yeon
me.text: You said you reach out first. Mostly. So you're carrying the whole chat and calling it "just being friendly".

them.speaker: bom
them.text: You said they reach out first. So they keep coming back. That means something. We'll find out what.

even.speaker: yeon
even.text: About even, you said. Fifty-fifty texting and zero-zero clarity. Impressive balance.

unsaid.speaker: bom
unsaid.text: You didn't say who texts first. That's okay. I'll read it from you instead.

strong.text:
Yeon: Strong chart. So here's your twist: you don't stay because you're scared. You stay because you think you're in charge of it.

Bom: You can leave any time. That's exactly why you haven't.

Yeon: "I'm in control" is a very comfy chair to sit in while nothing changes.

Pick a date one month from now. On that day, ask yourself three things: am I getting what I want, have I said what I want, did anything change after I said it. Three no's and the chair goes.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You can leave any time, so you never do. Cute. Pick on purpose.

weak.text:
Bom: Your chart runs soft. You give a lot, and you notice everything they don't give back.

Yeon: And then you explain it away. "They're busy." "They're bad at texting." They managed to post a story, babe.

Bom: Staying isn't the problem. Staying quiet is.

One small test this week: say one true thing you want, out loud, in one sentence. Not a hint. Not a meme. Then watch what they do with it.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Soft isn't weak. Soft just needs to stop apologising.

rat.text: The Rat sits closest to your heart: clever, private, awake at night. You figured this person out fast and you're keeping your cards close. Maybe too close. They can't answer a question you never ask.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Rat heart: you've got a whole strategy and no actual sentence.

ox.text: The Ox guards your heart: slow, steady, loyal past the point of sense. You don't attach fast, but once you do you hold the line for months. Ask whether the line is worth it.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Ox heart: slow to trust, impossible to shake off. Choose wisely.

tiger.text: The Tiger sits in your heart: brave, independent, bored by games. Part of you wants to just ask them straight. Another part refuses to look like the one who wanted it first. Tigers hate losing.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Tiger heart: you'd jump off a cliff before you'd say "I like you" first.

rabbit.text: The Rabbit lives close to your heart: gentle, charming, allergic to conflict. You'll keep the peace even if the peace is starving you. Wanting clarity isn't starting a fight.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Rabbit heart: asking isn't attacking. Promise.

dragon.text: The Dragon guards your heart: big dreams, big standards. You want something grand and you're quietly insulted this is the version on offer. Trust that instinct.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Dragon heart in a half-relationship. You're cosplaying low standards.

snake.text: The Snake sits closest to your heart: intuitive, private, strategic. You've already read this person completely. You're just waiting to see if they'll prove you wrong.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Snake heart: you clocked them on day one. Stop pretending you didn't.

horse.text: The Horse lives in your heart: passionate, restless, needs to run. The intensity of this thing is half the appeal. The other half is that nobody's fenced you in. Yet.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Horse heart: you want fire and freedom. Ask for both, out loud.

goat.text: The Goat guards your heart: gentle, homey, hungry for reassurance. You need to feel safe to open up, and a situationship is built to never feel quite safe. That's not you being needy. That's the setup.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Goat heart: wanting reassurance is normal. Ask for it.

monkey.text: The Monkey sits in your heart: clever, playful, a little restless. The banter is the best part, and you're scared that defining it will kill the fun. It won't. Fun survives labels.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Monkey heart: you'd rather keep the bit going than say one sincere thing.

rooster.text: The Rooster guards your heart: proud, precise, sees every flaw. You've noticed every red flag, catalogued it, and stayed anyway. Your standards are fine. It's your follow-through.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Rooster heart: you've got a full list of their flaws and still no exit.

dog.text: The Dog lives close to your heart: loyal, protective, principled. You decided early that they're worth it, and you're loyal to that decision even when the evidence wobbles. Loyalty wants a clear person to be loyal to.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Dog heart: loyal before they've earned it. Ask what you're guarding.

pig.text: The Pig sits in your heart: sweet, generous, trusting. You give people the benefit of the doubt over and over. Give yourself some too. You're allowed to want more than this.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Pig heart: your trust is a gift. Don't hand it out on a loop.

day_branch_heading: Who you let in close: the {day_animal} ({day_branch})

base.why-you-stay:
You don't quit things. Not jobs, not plans, not people. Quitting feels like admitting the project failed.

Bom: So you stay, and you call it patience.

Yeon: You're not being patient. You're watering a plant that told you it's plastic.

Bom: Ask yourself one honest question. Am I here because this feels good now, or because I already put so much in?

Yeon: Only one of those is romance. The other is a sunk cost with nice hair.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You see so much potential in them. You see potential in everything. It's honestly sweet.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: Potential isn't a relationship. It's a pitch deck. And you're the only investor.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You'd never stay in a job this unclear. Something about them made you break your own rules.

spring.intro: Spring birthday. That's tree season, so you got a double shot of yourself: taller, louder, surer. In saju terms, Wood ran the month you were born in. In real life, you've never once waited to be picked.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Double Wood. So the stubbornness is seasonal AND personal. Great.

summer.intro: You're a tree born in the heat. All that growing goes straight into showing: big plans, big talk, big gestures. Summer burns through a pine fast, so you look unstoppable right up until you suddenly need three days in bed.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You give off so much light. Just save a little for yourself.

autumn.intro: Autumn is axe season, and you're the tree. Life started trimming you early: rules, pressure, people with opinions. It made you sharper and more disciplined than other pines. It also made you allergic to being told what to do.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Pruned young. Explains the posture. And the attitude.

winter.intro: A winter pine. The cold kept you quiet on the outside while the roots drank everything. You think longer than you let on, and when you finally move, it's because you already decided weeks ago.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You look calm. Underneath, you've been planning since November.

earth.intro: Born in the between-season weeks, when soil runs the show. For a tree, that means work: you're always building, fixing, providing. Very useful. Very tired. Somebody should ask what you want for once.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Rest is not a prize you win. It's allowed.

open.title: You hate vague. So why are you in the vaguest thing alive?
open.text:
You're the person who books the restaurant, picks the date and has a five-year plan in the notes app. And right now you're refreshing a chat to see if they've read your message.

Bom: You don't usually wait for anyone.

Yeon: Exactly. Which is how we know this one got to you.
open.end: Yeon: But "they got to me" isn't the real reason you're still in it. The real reason is more embarrassing. Next page.

cliff.text: Yeon: Here's where this actually stands, Pine. They're not confused about you. They're | comfortable, and comfortable people don't upgrade anything.

sample.text: You're allowed to ask "what are we". You ask your dentist harder questions.

base.why-you-stay:
Vines grow toward whatever's there. That's not weak. That's how you survive. But it means you can wrap yourself around someone who never agreed to be the wall.

Yeon: You've learned their moods, their schedule, their humour. Name one thing they've learned about you.

Bom: Take your time.

Yeon: I'll wait. They clearly won't.

Bom: You stay because leaving means admitting you wanted more. And wanting more has always felt like being "too much".

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You're so good at being easy to be around. You make everything feel light.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: "Easy to be around" is a job title. And you've been working unpaid overtime.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You've adjusted your whole life around their schedule. I don't think they've noticed yet.

spring.intro: Spring birthday for the vine. Everything around you was growing, so you learned to grow toward whatever held still long enough. Charming. Flexible. Absolutely capable of getting your way while people believe they chose it.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Double Wood vine. You don't push. You wrap. Same result.

summer.intro: A flower in full sun. You bloom in public: the outfit, the story, the laugh across the room. The cost is that you wilt on the inside when nobody's watering you, and you'd rather die than ask.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You're so easy to love. You just don't always let anyone try.

autumn.intro: Autumn is cutting season, and you're the soft stem. You grew up reading rooms for danger, learning who's sharp and how to bend before they swing. That's why you're so good with people. It's also why you apologise to furniture.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You flinch at "can we talk" like it's a fire alarm.

winter.intro: A winter flower. Cold outside, so you grew inward: rich head, private feelings, a whole inner world nobody gets the password to. When you trust someone, it's total. Getting there takes a season.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Your inside is so much warmer than you let people see.

earth.intro: Born in the weeks between seasons, when the soil takes over. For a vine, that means you grow by managing things: schedules, people, plans. You're the reason the group trip happened. Nobody thanked you properly.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Unpaid project manager of every friendship. Since birth.

open.title: You're not chill. You're just very good at looking chill.
open.text:
You've typed "haha no worries" while worrying. You've said "whatever works for you" when one specific thing would work for you.

Bom: You bend so you don't lose them.

Yeon: And they think that's just your personality. Free flexibility. Bottomless.
open.end: Bom: There's a reason bending feels safer than asking. And it's older than this person.

cliff.text: Yeon: Where this stands, Flower? You've been so easy that they've never | had to decide anything. That's on purpose, and it's not yours.

sample.text: Being low-maintenance is not a love language. It's a discount.

base.why-you-stay:
You stay because when they do light up, it's the best feeling in your whole week. One good night and you'll forgive three weeks of dry replies.

Bom: You're not naive. You just believe in warmth.

Yeon: You're on a slot machine. Pull, nothing, nothing, nothing, jackpot. Pull again.

Bom: The highs are real. So is the waiting.

Yeon: Count how many days a month you actually feel good about this. Then decide if you'd accept that from a friend.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You make them feel like the most interesting person in the room. Nobody does it like you.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: And then they leave you on read for six hours. While watching your story.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You're a whole sun, waiting on a reply like it's a weather forecast. That tells me how much you care.

spring.intro: The sun, born in spring. Everything was feeding you: new leaves, longer days, people who wanted your attention. So you grew up assuming warmth is normal. When someone's cold to you, it genuinely confuses you.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Rooms get brighter when you arrive. That is not nothing.

summer.intro: The sun at noon in July. Double fire. You don't enter rooms, you arrive. Generous, loud, impossible to ignore, and secretly a little hurt every time someone doesn't notice you lit the place up.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Main character, sequel, director's cut. All you.

autumn.intro: An autumn sun. Lower in the sky, aimed at things: harvest, goals, results. You're warm, but you're also counting. You notice exactly who showed up for you and who just liked the post.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Warm and keeping score. Your sunshine comes with receipts.

winter.intro: A winter sun. Short days, cold air, people who needed you more than they could give back. It made you tough and a little performative: the brightest one in the room, even on the days you're running on fumes.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You shine hardest when you're the most tired. I see it.

earth.intro: Born in the between-season weeks, when Earth runs things. For the sun, that means everything you give turns into something solid: a friend's confidence, a plan that worked, a party you made happen. You're a great investment. Ask what you're getting back.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You fund everyone's glow-up and forget to invoice.

open.title: You light up their whole week. They text back "lol".
open.text:
You give attention like it's free, because for you it kind of is. Voice notes. Inside jokes. The meme you saw and thought "they'd love this".

Bom: You're generous with your light.

Yeon: Generous is one word. Another word is "doing all the shining in a two-person show".
open.end: Yeon: The question isn't why they're lukewarm. It's why lukewarm keeps working on you. Turn the page.

cliff.text: Yeon: Here's where it stands, Sun. You're their favourite person to | be around and their last person to commit to. Both can be true.

sample.text: Stop performing "unbothered" for someone who isn't even watching.

base.why-you-stay:
You stay because you already chose them. In your head, the decision was made weeks ago. Now you're just waiting for them to catch up.

Bom: And when you choose, you're loyal. Deeply.

Yeon: You're loyal to someone who hasn't applied for the position.

Bom: You also stay because the small moments are so good. The one late call. The one "thought of you".

Yeon: You're living on crumbs and calling it a candlelit dinner.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: When you care about someone, you care with your whole chest. Quietly. Completely.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: You've reread their last message so many times you could perform it as a monologue.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You noticed the full stop at the end of their "ok." You notice everything when you care.

spring.intro: A candle lit in spring. Fed from every side, so your warmth is steady and close: one person, one conversation, the whole night. You'd take a deep two-hour talk over a party of fifty every single time.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: When you pay attention to someone, they feel chosen.

summer.intro: A candle in midsummer. Double fire, so the flame runs hot: intense focus, intense loyalty, intense feelings you insist are "fine". You don't do half anything. That includes holding a grudge.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You remember a tone of voice from 2019. Word for word.

autumn.intro: A candle in autumn, burning toward a goal. You're quietly ambitious, a little perfectionist, and you light up most when you're useful. The danger is that you start to believe useful is the only way to be loved.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You don't have to earn the warmth you give everyone else.

winter.intro: A candle in winter. Cold all around, so your small flame matters more. You grew up being the warm one in a chilly place, which made you protective, careful, and very good at sensing a mood change from the next room.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You can hear a sigh through a closed door. Through two.

earth.intro: Born in the soil weeks between seasons. Your candle burns into the ground: caring, fixing, holding people together. You make every space feel like home. You also over-give until the wax runs out.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You hosted everyone's crisis. Who's hosting yours?

open.title: You read "ok." with a full stop and lost a night's sleep.
open.text:
You don't do casual feelings. You do one person, fully, in the dark, with a playlist. And they're over there treating it like a group chat.

Bom: Your attention is a gift.

Yeon: Your attention is a full-time surveillance operation with zero budget.
open.end: Bom: There's a reason you hold on this tight. It's not them. It's what letting go has felt like before.

cliff.text: Yeon: Where this stands, Candle? You're having a relationship. They're having | a nice time. Those aren't the same, and you know which one hurts.

sample.text: Draft the message. Read it once. Send it before you edit the soul out of it.

base.why-you-stay:
You stay because it's stable. Not great, not terrible. Predictable. And predictable feels safe to a mountain.

Bom: You don't need fireworks. You need consistency.

Yeon: So you settled for consistently unclear.

Bom: You also hate starting over. New people mean new explaining.

Yeon: "I don't want to start from zero" is how you've stayed at four out of ten for this long.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You're so steady. Whatever happens, you're the constant. That's rare.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: They always know you'll be there. That's exactly why they don't hurry.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: Mountains don't move. That's why your feelings are so real once they're there.

spring.intro: A mountain in spring, with trees pushing through it from every side. Life tested you early. That's why you're so steady now, and also why "relax" sounds to you like a trick.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You became the calm one because someone had to.

summer.intro: A summer mountain, warmed all the way through. Solid, generous, the one everyone leans on. You give off safety without trying. People tell you things they've never told anyone, and you never repeat them.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: People feel safe with you within five minutes. Rare.

autumn.intro: An autumn mountain, showing its stone. You turn your weight into output: work done, things built, problems quietly solved. You don't talk about feelings much. You show them by fixing the shelf.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Love language: unasked-for repairs. Every time.

winter.intro: A mountain in winter, holding back the river. You manage things: money, plans, other people's chaos. Very good at it. The cost is that you rarely let anything thaw, including you.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You're not cold. You're frozen on purpose. Different.

earth.intro: A mountain born in Earth's own weeks. Triple solid. You don't move unless you want to, and you almost never want to. Your loyalty is legendary. So is the time it takes you to change your mind.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Persuading you is a geological process.

open.title: You're not waiting for them. You're just not moving. Different.
open.text:
You don't chase. You don't beg. You just stay exactly where you are and let them come to you. Very dignified. Very slow.

Bom: You're patient because you're secure.

Yeon: You're patient because asking would mean feeling something on purpose.
open.end: Yeon: And there's one thing about mountains this person figured out very fast. Next page.

cliff.text: Yeon: Where it stands, Mountain: they know you won't leave, so | they've stopped trying to make you stay. Read that twice.

sample.text: No speech required. One sentence, and the nerve not to take it back.

base.why-you-stay:
You stay because you're needed, and being needed feels like being chosen. It isn't. It's close. That's what makes it so hard to see.

Bom: You also worry that if you stop giving, there won't be anything left between you.

Yeon: So you're scared the only thing holding this up is your effort. Babe. Listen to that sentence.

Bom: Try giving a little less for one week. Not to punish. Just to see what's actually there.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You look after them. You remember their exams, their bad days, their coffee order. That's love.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: That's also a free assistant with benefits. Do they know your coffee order?

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You've made their life so easy. I want someone to make yours easy too.

spring.intro: A garden in spring, with everything sprouting from you at once. You grew up being needed: the friend who listens, the kid who helped. Lovely trait. Exhausting default.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You nourish everybody. Your turn next.

summer.intro: Garden soil in summer, warm and rich. You're nurturing on instinct and practical about it: snacks in the bag, charger for everyone, a plan B nobody asked for. Everyone feels a bit safer near you.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You packed plasters for a picnic. Twice.

autumn.intro: A harvest-season garden. Everything you grow, you hand out. Ideas, help, advice, food. The harvest is real, but so is the empty field afterwards, and you never schedule time to grow back.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Giving is your gift. Refilling is your homework.

winter.intro: A winter garden. Frozen on top, busy underneath. You worry productively: lists, backups, a mental spreadsheet of who needs what. You keep it together for everyone, and you'd never admit you're scared too.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You overthink in organised folders. Colour-coded.

earth.intro: Soil born in soil weeks. Double Earth. You're the steady one, the reliable one, the one who remembers birthdays. You can also absorb other people's moods like a sponge and call it "being supportive".

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Their mood, your weekend. Every time.

open.title: You're the best part of their life. They just haven't said so.
open.text:
You check in. You send the article. You ask how the thing went. You make their life a little softer every single week.

Bom: You're a natural carer.

Yeon: You're running a wellness programme for one ungrateful client.
open.end: Bom: Caring isn't the mistake here. But there's one thing you keep not asking for. Turn the page.

cliff.text: Yeon: Here's where it stands, Field. They like how you make them feel. Whether | they like you enough to choose you is a separate question, and you've never asked it.

sample.text: Asking for what you want is not "being demanding". It's being a person.

base.why-you-stay:
You stay because walking away feels like losing. And Swords don't lose. You'd rather stand in the rain than admit you're wet.

Bom: You're also loyal before you're sure. Once you're in, you're in.

Yeon: Loyalty to an unclear thing is just stubbornness in a nice jacket.

Bom: Underneath it, you want someone to choose you without being asked.

Yeon: Correct. And they won't. So someone's going to have to use words. Guess who.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You'd defend them in public, fix their car, show up at 2am. You're loyal like nobody else.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: And you'll do all of that without once saying "I like you" out loud. Iconic. Unhelpful.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You're blunt with everyone except the one person who'd actually need to hear it. That's how I know it matters.

spring.intro: A blade born in spring, surrounded by things to cut. You see what needs doing and you do it, preferably before anyone has finished explaining. Efficient. Also sometimes the reason the meeting went badly.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You solved their problem. They wanted a hug. Classic.

summer.intro: A sword forged in summer. Heat everywhere, so you were shaped by pressure: deadlines, expectations, people who pushed. It made you strong and principled. It also made you assume love is a test you can fail.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You don't have to pass anything. You're already loved.

autumn.intro: A sword born in autumn, metal's own season. Double steel. Loyal to the bone, blunt as a brick, and fair in a way that scares people. You'd fight anyone for a friend, and tell that friend exactly where they went wrong on the way home.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You'd take a bullet for a friend. Then critique their aim.

winter.intro: A blade in winter. Cold, clear, and sharpened by thinking. You say less than other Swords, but when you speak it lands like a verdict. People quote you back to yourself years later.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Your words stay with people. Choose the kind ones too.

earth.intro: A sword still in the stone. Born in the soil weeks, so you were held, fed and protected before you were ever swung. That gives you patience most Swords lack, and a stubborn streak made of actual rock.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Patient, until you're not. Then it's a sword.

open.title: You'll fight anyone for them. Except them, about this.
open.text:
You tell your friends exactly what's wrong with their partners. Your boss gets your honest opinion whether they asked or not. And with this person? Silence. Strategic, stubborn silence.

Bom: You go quiet when it matters.

Yeon: You're not being mysterious. You're testing them. You've been testing them for weeks.
open.end: Yeon: And they keep failing a test they don't know they're taking. Let's talk about why. Next page.

cliff.text: Yeon: Where this stands, Sword: they read your silence as | "fine with it". You meant it as a warning. Nobody got the memo.

sample.text: Talk to them like you'd talk to a friend's bad boyfriend. Clear. Short. Then stop.

base.why-you-stay:
You stay because you want to be chosen, not to ask. Asking feels like admitting you're not sure you're worth choosing.

Bom: You're worth choosing. Obviously.

Yeon: Then why are you auditioning? Every message is a little performance.

Bom: You also stay because they make you feel seen when they do pay attention. Like a jewel in the right light.

Yeon: Gorgeous. But you can't live in the one hour a week the light hits.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You have such good taste. When you pick someone, it means something.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: You picked them. They're still browsing. That's the situation.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You curate every reply so it looks effortless. That's a lot of effort for someone who's never sure.

spring.intro: A jewel born in spring. Everything was growing and you noticed all of it: what's pretty, what's off, what's three millimetres crooked. You have taste. You also have opinions about other people's taste.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You judged the font on their birthday card. Silently.

summer.intro: A jewel in summer heat. Pressure shaped you: to look good, do well, never be the embarrassing one. You're polished and impressive. One careless comment can still ruin your whole week.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You're allowed to be unfinished. It's charming, honestly.

autumn.intro: A jewel born in metal's own season. Double shine. High standards, sharp eye, zero patience for sloppy. You're the friend people dress up for. You're also the friend people are slightly scared to disappoint.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You're a five-star review. With a long comment section.

winter.intro: A jewel in winter water, washed clear. Your mind is quick and your words are precise. You can say one sentence that fixes everything, or one that ends everything. Most of the time you know which.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You see people so clearly. Use it to be kind.

earth.intro: A jewel still in the earth. Born in the soil weeks, so you were protected, maybe a little over-protected. You need to feel safe before you sparkle, and that's not a flaw. It's quality control.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You need three green flags before one selfie.

open.title: Three drafts per "haha". And you call this casual.
open.text:
You time your replies. You choose the emoji carefully. You'd rather vanish than look like you care more than they do.

Bom: You protect your heart by looking polished.

Yeon: You're playing it cool so hard you're giving them frostbite.
open.end: Bom: The thing is, you're waiting for proof before you shine. And they're waiting for a signal. Next page.

cliff.text: Yeon: Where it stands, Jewel? They think you're fine with this because | you made it look so easy. Your polish is working against you.

sample.text: Wanting a label isn't needy. It's quality control. You have standards everywhere else.

base.why-you-stay:
You stay because this way nobody's trapped. Not them, not you. You can drift close and drift out and nobody has to explain.

Bom: Commitment can feel like a cage to you. That's real.

Yeon: Or the cage is the excuse, and the real fear is someone seeing all of you and leaving anyway.

Bom: Ask yourself what you'd do if they asked for official tomorrow.

Yeon: If your stomach dropped, that's an answer. If it lit up, that's a louder one.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You love freedom. You like the space this gives you. That's honest.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: You love freedom until they post a photo with someone new. Then suddenly you're very interested in labels.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You keep it vague so nobody can leave you. I get it. Big heart, small risk.

spring.intro: The ocean in spring, pouring itself into everything that grows. You're full of ideas and you give them away: plans, pep talks, 3am theories. People feel bigger around you. You sometimes feel emptier after.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You make people feel possible. Keep a little for you.

summer.intro: The ocean in summer, chasing everything. Big appetite for life: trips, people, projects, the next thing. You're magnetic and hard to pin down. Being pinned down is honestly your nightmare.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You said "let's see where it goes". You meant "don't make me commit".

autumn.intro: The ocean in autumn, fed by every stream. Deep, informed, a little too clever. You absorb everything and you can talk your way out of anything. That includes your own feelings.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You intellectualise heartbreak. With footnotes.

winter.intro: The ocean in winter. Double water. Deep, cold on top, enormous underneath. You need a lot of freedom and you think in huge loops. People call you mysterious. You just haven't decided yet.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Your depth scares shallow people. That's their problem.

earth.intro: An ocean held by cliffs. Born in the soil weeks, so you grew up with banks and rules around you. It gave you focus. It also left you with a quiet itch to flood something just to prove you can.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You follow every rule. Until one random Tuesday.

open.title: You like it vague. Until you don't. Usually around 2am.
open.text:
By day you're relaxed about it. "We're just vibing." By night you're three hours into a theory about what their last text really meant.

Bom: You're deep, and depth needs room.

Yeon: You've got so much room in this thing nobody can find each other.
open.end: Yeon: The ocean's favourite trick is "I'm fine either way". Next page, we check if that's true.

cliff.text: Yeon: Where this stands, Ocean: you're both keeping it loose so nobody | gets hurt. Fun fact, that's the exact setup where everybody gets hurt.

sample.text: "Let's see where it goes" is not a plan. It's a weather report.

base.why-you-stay:
You stay because you can feel the good in them. Under the mixed signals, you sense something real. And you're usually right about people.

Bom: That's your gift.

Yeon: It's also your trap. Feeling someone's potential isn't the same as getting it.

Bom: You also stay quiet because saying it out loud makes it real, and real can end.

Yeon: Unsaid things don't stay safe. They just go stale.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You feel them so clearly. You know when they're sad before they say anything.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: You know everything about how they feel. They don't know a single thing about how you feel.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: You've written them a whole message in your notes app. It's beautiful. It's also unsent since March.

spring.intro: Spring rain. You feed everything around you without anyone noticing it was you. You sense moods, fix vibes, water other people's plants. Quietly essential. Quietly forgotten. Not anymore.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Everything grows a little when you're around.

summer.intro: Rain in summer, gone the moment it lands. You chase what you want in quiet, clever ways, and you vanish when a room gets too loud. People find you fascinating. They also never quite know where you went.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You left the party without saying bye. Again. Iconic.

autumn.intro: Autumn rain, fed by cool clean air. Intuitive to the point of spooky. You know who's lying, who's sad, and who's about to text before your phone even lights up.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Your gut is right more often than your decisions are.

winter.intro: Winter rain. Double water. Still, deep, mostly internal. You feel everything at full volume and show about four percent of it. Your notes app has more emotional range than most novels.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Your quiet isn't empty. It's full.

earth.intro: Rain falling on hard ground. Born in the soil weeks, so you met walls early: rules, expectations, people who didn't get you. You learned to soak in slowly instead of crashing through. Patient. Persistent. Underrated.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You don't fight walls. You just wear them down. Over years.

open.title: You've written the perfect message. It lives in your notes app.
open.text:
You read every signal. The late reply. The heart instead of a real answer. The way they said "we should" and never did. You notice all of it and say none of it.

Bom: Your intuition is scary good.

Yeon: Your intuition has a PhD and zero speaking rights.
open.end: Bom: And your gut already knows where this is going. The next page is just where you let it talk.

cliff.text: Yeon: Where it stands, Rain? Your gut decided weeks ago. The only | thing still undecided is whether you'll listen to it.

sample.text: Send the notes-app message. Edited, shorter, braver. But send it.
